description: Reduced the fused shared-memory CholeskyQR launch from 256 threads to one 32-thread warp. Validation passed unchanged, but n=176 regressed from 8142.399 to 8939.626 us and aggregate to 58258.840912 us; the kernel needs the original block-level parallelism.

Added true dynamic-cluster Rayleigh-Ritz after post-solve Householder QR: form each cluster projection from the tridiagonal d/e, solve it with batched SYEVD, rotate the cluster basis, then backtransform and certify. All 39 tests pass, but full metric regresses to 50967.096 us; standard/mixed/nearrank/geometric are 97126/421095/272476/758844 us. Exact failures remain mixed 22/60, near-rank 35/60, geometric 16/60, essentially unchanged from QR-only 22/34/15, proving projected diagonalization adds large dynamic-width solver cost without repairing the residual failure mode.

Replaced sparse full-matrix RR with a fixed 128-column local block: retain every failed column, fill with nearest index neighbors, gather Q/AQ, form strict-FP32 projected block, run six sorted Jacobi sweeps, scatter, recertify, and combine residuals with dense exact fallback. Build/kernelguard passed; validation 39/39. Metric 25522.015112 us; mixed 110939.522 us and geometric 96417.666 us. Profile shows the selector itself costs 5.23 ms, RR does not repair any matrix (fallback remains 12), and total target regression is ~7.6 ms; reject local index-block RR.
